thread:
Leah: Heads-up: we're GA'ing the Hosted Streaming/Toolcall Unification today at 11:00 PT. This merges the streamed tool-calling flow into a single /v2/toolcall endpoint with improved manifest handling and streaming frames. Migration guide: https://internal.redwood.dev/toolcall-unify.

Ravi: Are there any fields removed? Will older clients error?

Leah: No fields removed. We added `tool_priority` and `tool_id` in streaming frames. Old clients will see a shim that preserves previous frame shapes for 30 days. After that, clients should upgrade to SDKs.

infra-bot: Canary deploy to us-west-2 started  job=4482 region=us-west-2 :rocket:

Sam: QA will run the long-stream stability test and tool-failure injection. Sharing results here.

docs-bot: Docs patch merged to main; site will rebuild automatically. One-pager for support uploaded to the internal drive.

Leah: Rollout plan: canary -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% across 8 hours. Monitoring: latency P95, stream disconnects, and fallback rate. Fallback route -> mosaic-lite non-streaming.

Ravi: Any billing or rate limit changes?

Leah: No billing changes for GA. We'll enable a soft quota in two weeks if adoption looks healthy.

Sam: Noted. If we see streaming disconnect >0.5% we'll pause ramp and investigate.

Leah: Thanks team. DM me for early canary access. We'll notify support before 11:00 PT. :thumbsup:
